relation: P_req + W c <= eta * E_O2 * Q * Ca  =>  Q * Ca >= (P_req + W c) / (eta * E_O2)

inputs.efficiency_source: top of the bat-measured range; bumblebee 7 to 15 %
inputs.oxycaloric_source: oxycaloric equivalent for mixed substrate; the bumblebee paper uses 21.1 J per ml CO2 for carbohydrate
inputs.P_req_source: physics/flier/spec.json power_budget.P_req_table (the physics thread's simulator, measured polar of Park and Choi 2010)

physicsFigure.note: the hub quoted 18.6 W metabolic for a 1 m/s climb at 0.06 kg, about 930 ml O2 per min per kg; the row at the minimum climb power reproduces it

missing: cardiac output Q and arterial O2 content Ca for a 60 g flying fish (no Exocoetidae physiology sourced); the gill-to-blood link is not formalised
whatWouldEliminate: a committed Q * Ca below the O2_needed_climb_ml_per_s of the chosen speed (C14 with climb_rate_m_s = 1), under the named hypotheses: Fick, aerobic (not burst) power, eta = 0.1 from bats, E_O2 = 20.1 J/ml
kernel: the arithmetic here is plain computation; a kernel certificate is generated by lean/eliminate/eliminate.mjs only when a candidate commits Q and Ca
